scope.target: Journal v5 for the Python AI context package-apply lifecycle
constraints: New transactions write and recover v5 only.
Unfinished v4 blocks new mutation; terminal v4 does not.
Every completed operation has a durable boundary.
Acceptance uses deterministic write-call and byte counts, not wall-clock timing.
non_goals: v4 recovery, rollback, migration, conversion, or dual-version compatibility
release-note, tag, release, or publication work

acceptance_criteria: v5 journal write amplification is linear or bounded
v5 crash recovery preserves exactly-once semantics
v4 safety classification never performs v4 recovery
optional progress never writes to stdout

steps: Resolve framework-source effective-rule evidence for each applicable routed action.
Implement journal v5 append-only durable progress and minimal v4 safety classification.
Implement deterministic journal I/O instrumentation and stderr-only progress.
Update owning validator, templates, tests, and documentation.
Run focused and proportionate broader validation.
Commit and obtain exact-head independent read-only review.
validation: focused package-apply journal v5 GWT tests

execution.next_action: Commit the transaction-root boundary repair, then repeat full fixed-head validation and independent read-only audit on the new immutable SHA.

results.summary: Journal v5 snapshots durable lifecycle state while newline-framed, fsynced, digest-chained progress records retain one durable boundary per completed apply or rollback operation with linear logical journal writes.
